positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Project:  eProducer 
o	Project Description: Verint's Content Producer is comprised of authoring, editing, and conversion tools to develop learning clips that engage your audience and provide educational information about a specific topic. Content Producer can be used either as a standalone product or as a power feature in a suite of several integrated applications named Impact 360 which was developed through many versions across global development centers including Vietnam. Actually, this product is acquired from another company, Qarbon. In this version 7.8.1, project team aims to be familiar with the source code of the application through some minor enhancements and customization.
o	Responsibility: Played roles as Principal Software Eng. Was doing maintenance fixing bug. Implemented new UI enhancements. eProducer is Java Application having Rich format UI like MS Word, Frontpage to design lesson. Enhanced AICC, SCORM export function. 
o	Technologies: Java, Swing, SpringMVC, JSP, Servlet, XML, JavaScript, AJAX, MySQL, Clear case, Onyx, Java 2 SWF


•	Project: Witness eLearning ( www.witness.com ), Atlanta, GA  2004- 2008

o	Responsibility: Played roles as Sr Java Software Eng. Doing whole analysis, design UI, Java Tier, DB, maintenance (Production support Tier 3) for eLearning Java web application. Implement new enhancements: Assignment component, Import Synchronize User, Score, Evaluation components. Improve Integration component performance, fixed bugs, documented the system (Use Case, Detail design etc…) . Have done for many releases 7.5, 7.6, 7.6.1, 7.6.2, 7.7, 7.7.1 in 2004-2008 period
o	Technologies: Java, Applet, Swing, JSP, Servlet, XML, JavaScript, MSSQL, Oracle, Clear case, Onyx.

positions.title: Java developer/Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Project: Unicon ( www.unicon.net ), USA April 2002-May 2004
o	Responsibility: Customize Calendar, Address Book modules in uPortal. Change some features, added new function import/export data to Outlook & Palm, Grouping calendars. Customize & fix bug of Briefcase, Notification (Send message), Forums, Survey modules in uPortal
o	Technologies: Java, EJB, JSP, Servlet, RAD framework, XML, XSLT, HTML, PostgreSQL, uPortal (www.ja-sig.org ), Apache web server, VSS, Tomcat

•	Project: Exchange Connector for Kansas University (www.ku.edu), USA Jan 2002 – April 2002
o	Responsibility: Analysis, Design, Develop middleware for connecting & synchronizing data between Calendar web application in uPortal and Calendar of MS Exchange server 2000.
o	Technologies: Java, Apache Web Dav, XML	

•	Project: Calendar for www.kinkos.com, USA Oct 2001- Jan 2002
o	Responsibility: Customize Calendar in uPortal. Change the feature of Calendar 2.0
o	Technologies: Java, EJB, JSP, Servlet, RAD framework, XML, XSLT, HTML, PostgreSQL, uPortal (www.ja-sig.org ), Apache web server, VSS, Tomcat

•	Project: Admission Online for Santa Barbara College, California, USA July 2001 – Oct 2001
o	Responsibility: Analysis, Design, develope an Admission web application. Student can use this software to register classes / enroll to school
o	Technologies: JSP, Servlet, Java Bean, HTML, JavaScript, Tomcat, MS SQL 

•	DPCS (Dan Phong Calendar server) Mar 2001- June 2001
o	Responsibility: Developed a calendar server implement iCal format like Sun iPlanet Calendar server or Oracle calendar serever
o	Technologies: Java, Bean, Tomcat, MS SQL
